etymologies.etymologyHTML: From urgent +‎ -ency or Latin urgentia.

definitions.definition: The quality or condition of being urgent.

quote.citation: 2011 September 24, David Ornstein, “Arsenal 3 - 0 Bolton”, in BBC Sport‎[1]:
quote.text: Arsenal lacked urgency and inspiration until shortly before half-time, Wheater's block denying Van Persie from close range before Walcott drilled wide.

definitions.definition: (medicine) A sudden and compelling need to urinate that is difficult to defer, associated with conditions such as urinary tract infections and overactive bladder.
